question.worked_solution:
If $F(x)$ is defined on $x\in [0,8),$ the odd extension of $F$ is the function $f$ such that

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}F(x), & x\in [0,8), \\ -F(-x), & x\in (-8,0).\end{aligned}
$$

In our case, for $x\in (-8,0),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =-F(-x) \\  & =-(-(-x)^{2}+5(-x)) \\  & =-(-{x}^{2}-5x) \\  & ={x}^{2}+5x.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(-3) & =(-3)^{2}+5(-3)=-6.\end{aligned}
$$
